title: FriendosCozyAdventure
description: This is a friendly neighborhood modpack! It contains a little bit of everything for everyone! From Create mod to Let's do Furniture to Aquaculture 2, this modpack is meant to enhance a lot of what you do!
body: A kitchen sink mod with lots of vanilla plus content, Create mod, and some engineering stuff to make things interesting! We've included a ton of stuff to make building your perfect base fun, as well as a lot to make interacting with the world more fulfilling! We hope that you'll have a ton of fun!
